findings.issue: `wave: final` is a string keyword, not a number >= 1 as the template specifies (`wave: 1`). Task 10 is also `wave: final`, so Task 11's `depends_on: [10]` points at a same-wave task rather than a strictly-earlier numeric wave.
findings.fix: Acceptable as-is IF the orchestrator supports named waves — this matches the project convention (tech-spec 'Final Wave'; Task 10 also uses `wave: final` and depends on the Audit Wave via depends_on). Ordering is correctly enforced by `depends_on: [10]`, so execution is not broken. If the runner expects numeric waves, replace `final` with the next integer after the audit/pre-deploy wave.

findings.issue: Leftover template guidance line retained above the real content: 'Конкретные шаги — ЧТО, не КАК. Не псевдокод.' (line 33). The actual numbered steps 1-6 follow it.
findings.fix: Delete the template instruction line; the concrete numbered steps already fulfil the section.

findings.issue: The Pre-deploy QA report entry (line 66) is plain text with an inline code path — 'Pre-deploy QA отчёт Task 10: `logs/working/qa-report.json`' — not a markdown link `[name](path)`. The path is also bare (`logs/working/...`), which resolves from CWD/project root, not the feature dir; actual location is `work/dedup-model-series/logs/working/`. Same bare path recurs in 'What to do' step 1 (line 35).
findings.fix: Convert to a markdown link anchored to the feature dir, e.g. `[qa-report.json](../logs/working/qa-report.json)`, and use the same feature-relative path in the 'What to do' step.

findings.issue: Details has no **Files:** subsection (template lists Files as the first subsection). Dependencies, Edge cases, and Implementation hints are all present and rich.
findings.fix: Acceptable adaptation for a non-code, report-only task that modifies no source files. Optionally add a one-line note ('No source files modified — output is a post-deploy-qa JSON report') to make the omission explicit.
